chunks: I said to Abu Ja'far عليه السلام: We discuss and say that whoever performs salat (prayer) while sitting, without any illness, then his prayer is two rak'ahs in place of one, and two prostrations in place of one.
So he said: It is not like that; it is complete for you.

key_terms.جَالِسٌ: sitting; the posture in which the salat (prayer) is performed
key_terms.عِلَّةٍ: illness or excuse preventing normal performance

ai.seo_question: Does salat (prayer) performed while sitting without illness count as reduced or complete?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a jurisprudential question about performing salat (prayer) while sitting without an excuse. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام rejects the reported claim that such a prayer counts as reduced in structure, and states that it is complete as performed.
